===== TEXT =====
Property Record Cards

The Assessor’s office is responsible for the maintenance of records on the ownership of properties. Assessments are computed at 70% of the estimated market value of real property at the time of the last revaluation which was 2025. A plus sign (+) at the end of a Map Block Lot (e.g., 23 52 7+) means three or more lots have been merged.

Information on the Property Records for the Municipality of Ashford was last updated on 08/26/2026.

Please select how you would like to search properties ...

Only one category should be used at a time. Then press Search.

You can combine selections like Residential Property Use and a location like Main Street.

If the search by owner is available, you may want to enter only the last name such as Smith instead of the whole name due to how properties are registered in the Assessor's Office.

If you don't select an item then it defaults to all. Example: If you don't select a location all locations will be searched.
